verdicts.explanation: The 4 x 10-4 S/cm value is the 0.10 Ce sample at room temperature, as stated in Section 3.4.1 and Table 2. The 0.29 eV activation energy, 1050 C / 8 h sintering, and 95.96% relative density (maximum, at 0.10 Ce, Section 3.2) all match the paper.
Table 2 gives 2.41 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.44 eV for Ce content 0 at room temperature. Relative density is correctly null for this composition, since the paper only reports density for the 0.10 Ce sample.
Table 2 gives 9.93 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.34 eV for Ce content 0.20 at room temperature. Sintering conditions match Section 2.1.
Table 2 gives 4.26 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.41 eV for Ce content 0.30 at room temperature. Sintering conditions match Section 2.1.
